claims.subject: Sliding cube model

claims.subject: Modular Robotic System
claims.evidence_quote: The most common movement primitives for MRSs on the Cartesian grid are the rotation and slide primitives (see Fig. 7b and c), and for MRSs on the triangular grid the rotation primitive (see Fig. 7a).
